What this proves—and what it doesn’t

Acceptance means citations and tool preconditions passed automated checks. Relevance means the selected tool matched a developer-written rubric. Neither is a free-text factual accuracy score or proof that five presenters outperform one model. The evidence studio uses one Azure planner with verified tools and source-rendered presenter roles.
